verbatim_quote.original: there is minor bug i used this systsem for a tool that the tool use cf, the cf has rate limit over ips. so it works when we rotated and balanced., but some of nodes already flaged as 429, i think if you can implemment a simple thing for me a api or someting even a command helper when i see a bad proxy or already flaged i run command it roated manually to next.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: There is a minor issue: I use this system for a tool that uses Cloudflare, which rate-limits IPs. It works while we rotate and balance, but some nodes are already flagged as 429. Implement a simple thing — an API or at least a command helper — so when I see a bad or already-flagged proxy I can run a command and it rotates manually to the next one.

extracted_decision.summary: Provide a manual rotate helper (API or command) to force rotation to the next alive node when a proxy is already flagged, e.g. Cloudflare 429.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager hits per-IP rate limits mid-work and needs immediate rotation.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Manual action required; overuse can drain the alive pool.
